item.title: Version 1.0.0-beta.2 (81)
item.description:
Trails RG Studio 1.0.0-beta.2

Build 81

  • Right-click a folder to find blank frames and frames that cannot be sharpened. You choose Archive or Trash.
  • Archive remembers where a file came from. Restore puts it back when that place is empty.
  • Settings is split into Cull, Performance, and Archive. Sort, filter, and size each have their own page.
  • A bar stays visible while a cull or a scan is running, including when the window is minimized.
